fields.description: Issue focuses on Miami municipal politics ahead of the Nov. 15, 1949 primary election, including an editorial attack on candidate Leonard K. Thomson and discussion of proposed consolidation of city and county tax assessor functions and its impact on property taxes. Reports cover allegations involving Cuban senator Jose Aleman and Miami-area immigration officials, labor conflict involving Herald pressmen, a petition against Southern Bell pay-station practices, and local public-safety and crime-related items including incidents at the Orange Bowl and municipal court cases. Includes candidate statements and local civic commentary, along with advertisements and community notices.
